basis: Accepted V48 map snapshot plus separately published dated source snapshots and a distinct publisher asking-listing inventory. This is not a live source-health result or a complete UAE census.

publisherListingInventory.method: Exact equality against the publisher location label; no title, URL, nearby district, or coordinate inference.
publisherListingInventory.reviewedAreaMethod: Exact publisher locationLabel alias matched to a previously reviewed OpenStreetMap area reference; the area reference has a separately reviewed emirate.
publisherListingInventory.limits: These are dated asking-listing facts, not registered transactions, project identities, project coordinates, or complete emirate inventories. Unassigned rows may still be located in one of the seven emirates; their location labels are not exact emirate names. Area references are approximate district or city locations. They do not verify a listing address, project identity, current availability, or registered transaction. Publisher emirate labels and reviewed area references remain separate.

Most source project IDs remain separate from V48 identities.

The historical published building-count series stops at 2019; 403 ambiguous export rows remain withheld. A separate 2026 Dubai Municipality permit-system snapshot has 536,946 building cards, but does not verify standing completed stock, building coordinates, available spaces, sales, or rents.

The licensed historical commercial-unit sales snapshot covers 2006–2025. The 2026 Office/Shop subtype series runs through October, but 4,319 rows have a conflicting Residential usage label and need source verification. It is partial-year registered sale evidence, not asking inventory or available spaces. A separate 2026 residential Flat sale aggregate covers January–October only; it contains no unit coordinates, rents or forecasts. A separate licensed Ejari rent aggregate covers 102 publisher communities and 418 bedroom rows, but its source CSV does not encode property class or exact observation dates; renewals are included and Palm Jabal Ali has no registered rent contracts in that snapshot.
